# Watchlr

> Watchlr is a movie and TV tracker with AI-powered summaries, ending explanations, spoiler-free reviews, and a mood-based recommendation chat. It helps people track what they watch, want to watch, and dropped — and decide what to watch tonight.

Watchlr is a free web app (also available as an Android app) built on data from TMDB. It is created by Tayyab Khan (https://justtayyabkhan.vercel.app/).

## What Watchlr does

- Track every film and episode: statuses for want-to-watch, watching, completed, favorite, dropped, and hidden. Movies log with one click; TV shows track per-episode progress.
- Rate and review titles (out of 10) and build custom collections.
- AI takes per title: five summary flavors — spoiler-free, detailed, ending explained, themes, and should-I-watch — plus a per-title chat that avoids spoilers.
- "Tonight": a conversational recommendation page. Describe your mood in plain words and Watchlr suggests titles with real posters, checking your own want-to-watch list before the wider catalogue.
- Daily AI picks: curated suggestions refreshed each day, each with a one-line reason.
- A stats dashboard: hours watched, weekly rhythm, genre breakdown, and a consistency heatmap.
- Public profiles and shareable lists for comparing taste and settling arguments.

## Public pages

- Home: https://watchlr.justtayyabkhan.com/
- Movie page: https://watchlr.justtayyabkhan.com/movie/{tmdb_id}
- TV show page: https://watchlr.justtayyabkhan.com/tv/{tmdb_id}
- Public list: https://watchlr.justtayyabkhan.com/list/{id}
- Public profile: https://watchlr.justtayyabkhan.com/{username}

## Attribution

Poster and title data comes from The Movie Database (TMDB). Watchlr uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
